tasks.prompt: Read specs/002-product-roadmap/spec.md, decisions.md and the R002-T033 entry in tasks.md. Prepare release notes, milestone/task evidence mapping and local packaging handoff only after acceptance and native gates pass. Implement only the declared scope, add the named verification coverage and record actual results. Preserve local-only state and coordinator-only execution. Do not install dependencies, access unrelated repositories, read environment files, publish, or grant approvals. Stop with a concrete blocked reason if a required approval, runtime or dependency is unavailable.
tasks.approval_requirements: Approve the documentation task only. Git publication, tags, releases, uploads, remote access and machine installation remain separate explicitly authorized operations.
acceptance: H2-H9 can be marked completed only when all required task verification, manual artifacts and blocker dispositions are present.
The handoff distinguishes local readiness from publication and lists an unexecuted signed-commit/tag/release procedure with explicit publication approval.
